text:
talia: Draft PR for Dedicated provisioning migration + a compact examples appendix (autoscale cooldowns, fallback behavior, and an updated Python SDK snippet). link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/534
ben: Skimming. Can you call out exactly what changed in the appendix?
talia: Added three short examples: 1) cooldown tuned for bursty inference, 2) cooldown tuned for steady steady-state, 3) YAML showing fallback_policy: compatible_fallback and rollout.canary.rollout_fraction. Also replaced an old allocate_tenant call in the Python snippet.
ben: Good. For the Python snippet please use ReserveCapacitySync (blocking) to match sdk v0.9.x naming; otherwise readers will hit an API mismatch.
talia: ack. Updated to ReserveCapacitySync. Snippet now:
```python
from redwood import Client
import os
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
client.ReserveCapacitySync(tenant_id="team-xyz", gpus=2, labels={"team": "search", "env": "prod"})
```
ops-bot: link-check: detected handbook/provisioning.md#isolation-example -> 404. Suggested anchor: handbook/provisioning.md#tenant-isolation. Auto-suggestion appended to branch.
docs-bot: md-lint: migration.md line ~130: long inline code block > 120 chars. Consider wrapping or using a fenced block.
ben: Also, clarify isolation terminology: infra currently accepts 'hard' or 'soft' not 'strict'. Add a mapping note: docs-term 'tenant_isolation: strict' -> infra 'tenant_isolation: hard' for earlier drafts, but prefer using 'hard' in examples to avoid mismatch.
talia: Will change examples to 'hard'/'soft' and add a short note about why we prefer 'hard'. Also expanded the 'eviction vs preemption' paragraph with two one-line examples: preemption = spot GPU reclaimed by provider (affects SLA), eviction = node drained for maintenance or tenant throttling (operational, may cause transient failures). Kept phrasing non-commitment.
ben: Nice. Can you also add a minimal test plan bullet for autoscale cooldown? e.g., "stage: simulate 3x QPS spike, assert system scales down after cooldown_seconds without oscillation"
talia: Added the test plan bullet and a TODO to fill regional preemption allowances table. CI will run link-check and md-lint on push. If green I'll merge after another pair of eyes. /cc @ben
